opportunities.name: United flight search (origin, destination, dates, travelers, cabin)
opportunities.description: On united.com fill the Book flight form with origin airport, destination airport, trip type, dates, travelers and cabin, then click Find flights to see fares.
steps: Open united.com Book > Flight tab
Select Roundtrip or One-way
Type origin city and pick the suggested airport
Type destination and pick the suggested airport
Open the date picker and select depart and return dates
Set number of travelers via the travelers dropdown
Optionally choose cabin (Economy/Premium economy)
Click Find flights and review the fare grid

instances.values: Columbus CMH -> Houston IAH, one-way with miles, Jun 02
Baltimore BWI -> New York NYC, roundtrip Aug 02-07, 2 adults

opportunities.name: Tripadvisor restaurant search with cuisine filter
opportunities.description: On Tripadvisor, open Restaurants, search a location, then filter results by cuisine (via Show more cuisine dialog) and review results.
steps: Click Restaurants tab on Tripadvisor home
Click Where to? and type location
Select matching suggestion
Scroll to Cuisine filter in left sidebar and click Show more
Tick desired cuisine and click Apply
Review/open restaurant results

instances.values: Central Park New York, cuisine Italian
Big Sur CA, restaurant features filter (outdoor seating)

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search with filters
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, search a venue, choose an event, optionally adjust time and apply amenity filters (e.g. wheelchair accessible) to list parking.
steps: Type venue in search box and select suggestion
Pick event from events dialog
Adjust enter-after/exit-before times and click Update Search
Open Filter and tick amenity (Wheelchair Accessible)
Click Show Results
Review garages/prices

opportunities.name: United Explore destinations map search
opportunities.description: Use United's map/flexible-dates explorer with a departure airport.
steps: Open Plan search / map search page
Type departure city in Flying from and pick suggestion
Set roundtrip and flexible dates
Click Search
